subject: Capture playbook and sign-off for Novus Health testimonial
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@novushealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Capture playbook and sign-off for Novus Health testimonial

Hi Alex & Priya —

Thanks again for agreeing to a customer video with Novus Health. I put together a short capture playbook and one-page run-of-show to keep the day efficient. High-level asks below, full attachments on the Drive link I shared.

Proposed dates:
- Wednesday 9/8 — On-site (preferred)
- Thursday 9/9 — Remote interview option (backup)

Crew: small two-camera interview + B-roll (producer: Dylan Brooks). We expect a 3-hour slot on-site: 60–90 min interview, 60–90 min b-roll/office captures.

What we need from Novus:
- Executive availability (25–30 minutes on camera + quick pre-brief)
- A short list of 2–3 customer stories/anecdotes to highlight (metrics if available)
- Signed release form (attached draft) — legal prefers DocuSign link but PDF works for review

Attachments included: novus_shotlist_v3.xlsx, release_form_v2.pdf, talking_points_v1.docx, dos_and_donts.pdf (stubs).

Next steps: please confirm preferred date and whether on-site is OK. If you need a remote-only option we can set up a high-quality remote shoot kit.

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Customer Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

From: Alex Grant <alex.grant@novushealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novushealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capture playbook and sign-off for Novus Health testimonial

Thanks Sofia — this looks great. Quick answers from our side:

- 9/8 on-site works for our leadership team (Mark and I can do the 10:00–11:30am slot).
- We appreciate the remote kit option as a fallback; if weather/ops prevents travel we’ll pivot to 9/9.
- Legal will want to review the release; please send the DocuSign link when ready.

A couple of content notes for script/talking points:
- We prefer a 30s highlight + 2.5–3min long form case study.
- Please avoid mentioning specific per-token or cost numbers in the video — we can provide outcomes like "reduced latency" and "improved throughput" but want to keep the exact pricing confidential.

Attaching one internal brief (not for share) — will share any internal brand/logo guidance if you need it.

Alex
Alex Grant
Director, Strategy & Partnerships, Novus Health
alex.grant@novushealth.com

> - 9/8 on-site works for our leadership team...

Thanks Alex — great. A few production details so everyone has the same expectations:

- Call time 09:30 for crew; interview window 10:00–11:30. Please clear meeting calendars for Mark at 09:30–12:00.
- Crew: 2 cameras (A/B), lav mic for each participant, shotgun for room ambience. Producer is Dylan Brooks (cc not included on this thread).
- Deliverables: 30s highlight + 3:00 case study + 5–6 stills from b-roll.
- Legal/Usage: standard Redwood release (we included the latest edits in release_form_v2.pdf). We will send a DocuSign envelope for signatures — expect that by EOD today.

Attachments referenced: novus_shotlist_v3.xlsx (run-of-show + shot list).

If Alex/Priya want us to prepare a 1-page prep sheet for the execs (talking prompts + do/don'ts) we can send that by tomorrow.

—Marcus

On Tue, Aug 24, 2027 at 08:30 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Alex — great. A few production details so everyone has the same expectations:

Perfect — thanks Marcus. Alex/Priya, I’m attaching the first draft of talking_points_v1.docx. It’s intentionally short: 6 bullets per exec (open, challenge, decision, outcome, metric if public, call to action).

Prep guidance highlights (do/don'ts):
- DO: mention concrete business outcomes (e.g., "reduced model latency by X" -> keep X qualitative like "significant")
- DO: tell a short anecdote about how the team used the platform to unblock a specific workflow
- DON'T: speculate about roadmap or pricing
- DON'T: use customer data or PHI on camera

DocuSign link (preview): https://docusign.com/novus/release/ABC123 — Marcus will route the envelope.

If you can confirm Mark and your CEO's preferred anecdotes by Thursday EOD we’ll finalize the shot list and talent brief.

Thanks,
Sofia

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novushealth.com>

All good from our side. Legal will review the release (they prefer DocuSign). I confirmed 9/8 for on-site; Mark and our CPO are locked for 10:00–11:30. They like the 30s highlight + 3min long form plan.

We will:
- Send logos and brand guidelines to Monica by tomorrow morning.
- Have our legal team review the DocuSign envelope and aim to return a signed copy by Friday EOD.
- Provide 2 short anecdotes for Mark by Thursday EOD.

Thanks everyone — excited to get this captured.

Best,
